cohort: 32 children hospitalized with recurrent wheezing symptoms (group A) and 23 children hospitalized for foreign body inhalation (group B)
finding: Children with recurrent wheezing have significant changes in their lower airway microbiota compared to children without recurrent wheezing.
mod_finding: Infants with recurrent wheezing had a significantly different mode of delivery compared to the control group.
gest_age: Mentioned as significantly different between groups
